title: Kuailu HR | Features & Modules
label: 04-Features & Modules
markdown:
# Kuailu HR | Features & Modules

The following feature inventory is transcribed from the supplied English feature-list workbook. Menu hierarchy is preserved and function/scenario text is separated for retrieval.

| Level 1 Menu | Level 2 Menu | Level 3 Menu | Function | Scenario |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Employee Management | Employee Roster | — | Employee master profile with sub-tabs for basic information, contact details, identification documents, family, education, health checkup, training, banking, performance, and overseas assignment. | HR-wide profile management, employee information query and update, full lifecycle information traceability, and compliance audit document retrieval. |
| Employee Management | Pending Onboarding | — | Receives hiring approval results, supports confirming onboarding, job abandonment, and automatic onboarding, and triggers creation of employee roster, attendance profile, and payroll profile. | Pre-onboarding procedures for new employees, automatic initialization of onboarding roster, and closed-loop management of abandoned onboarding cases. |
| Employee Management | Contract Management | — | Effective contract management for employees in active employment status, supporting initial contract signing and contract renewal. | Full lifecycle management of employee labor contracts, contract expiration renewal reminders, labor compliance risk control, and contract archive query and audit. |
| Employee Management | HR Forms | Interview & Compensation | Integrates with the recruitment module for pre-onboarding processes; can automatically initiate workflows through process automation. | Follow-up on interview results for experienced hires and campus recruits, compensation package approval, pre-onboarding document verification for new employees, and seamless end-to-end process from recruitment to onboarding. |
| Employee Management | HR Forms | Onboarding | Application and record viewing for employee onboarding, transfer, and offboarding documents; supports employee lifecycle management. | New employee onboarding procedures, onboarding document review and archiving, onboarding process tracking, and full-process record query of employee onboarding status. |
| Employee Management | HR Forms | Regularization | Supports employee regularization applications, probation assessments, and full-process regularization approval management; synchronously updates employee profile status. | Probation regularization procedures, implementation of probation assessment results, and profile updates for employee regularization status. |
| Employee Management | HR Forms | Transfer | Supports full-process approval and management of internal transfers, cross-department transfers, position adjustments, and job level changes; synchronously updates employee profile, attendance, and payroll master data. | Internal position adjustment procedures, cross-department transfer approval, job level change management, and master data synchronization after transfers. |
| Employee Management | HR Forms | Offboarding | Supports employee offboarding applications, offboarding approval, and full-process work handover management; can integrate with attendance and payroll modules to automatically calculate final pay, and synchronously updates employee employment status. | Employee offboarding procedures, offboarding handover tracking, final pay calculation and settlement, offboarding profile archiving, and offboarding employee status management. |
| Employee Management | Basic Settings | Work Location | Entry point for enterprise organization basic data maintenance; supports adding, editing, deactivating, and hierarchical management of work locations, countries/regions, and job level systems; provides foundational data support for employee profiles, attendance, payroll, and organization management. | Enterprise organization basic information initialization, job level system setup and maintenance, office location information management, cross-region employee information adaptation, and foundational data compliance maintenance. |
| Employee Management | Basic Settings | Country/Region | — | — |
| Employee Management | Basic Settings | Job Level | — | — |
| Employee Management | Basic Settings | Process Automation | Customizable switches for automatically creating onboarding forms, attendance profiles, and payroll profiles; supports automated triggering of core HR business processes, node configuration, and custom rules. | Automated triggering of full onboarding workflows, automatic employee profile initialization, automatic synchronization of attendance and payroll profiles, improved HR process efficiency, and implementation of standardized processes. |
| Attendance Management | Attendance Profile | Process Automation | Foundational personnel management for the attendance module; supports enabling/disabling attendance personnel, attendance profile initialization, attendance assignment adjustments, and synchronization of employment status and organization information from the employee roster. | Enterprise attendance personnel scope management, automatic attendance profile creation for new hires, attendance assignment adjustment after job changes, deactivation of attendance profiles for offboarded employees, and basic personnel data maintenance in the attendance module. |
| Attendance Management | Attendance Group | Process Automation | Groups departments or personnel with the same attendance shifts, clock-in rules, overtime rules, clock correction rules, and outing/business trip rules for unified management; supports batch rule configuration, personnel adjustment within groups, and batch activation/deactivation of rules. | Differentiated attendance rule management across departments and positions, batch rule configuration for same-shift personnel, temporary attendance rule setup for cross-department project teams, and unified control of batch attendance rule adjustments. |
| Attendance Management | Attendance Shift | Process Automation | Configures all shift information for the enterprise; applied through attendance groups and attendance profiles; supports fixed shifts, flexible shifts, rotating shifts, and cross-day shifts; allows customization of work start/end times, clock-in periods, break periods, and late arrival/early departure criteria. | Shift system setup for different positions, fixed-position and flexible shift configuration, and full lifecycle management of attendance shifts. |
| Attendance Management | Scheduling Management | Process Automation | Supports different scheduling rules and scheduling record viewing. | Scheduling requirements for different scenarios; supports manual daily or periodic scheduling, or automatic fixed-shift scheduling by the system. |
| Attendance Management | Attendance Settings | Attendance Item | Defines all attendance fields and types used for attendance calculation and attendance reports; supports custom field names, data types, calculation rules, and statistical criteria; can link to attendance rules, leave rules, and overtime rules for automatic calculation; adapts to enterprise-specific attendance reporting needs. | Enterprise-specific attendance indicator system setup, custom configuration of attendance calculation fields, extension of attendance report dimensions, field adaptation for special attendance scenarios, and unified standardization of attendance data criteria. |
| Attendance Management | Attendance Settings | Holidays | Requires annual maintenance; after import, data can be updated to the work calendar; supports national statutory holidays, enterprise custom rest days, and compensatory leave days via batch import and manual maintenance; can automatically sync to attendance calculation, scheduling management, and leave quota calculation; distinguishes attendance rules for workdays, rest days, and statutory holidays. | Enterprise annual work calendar setup and maintenance, synchronization of national statutory holidays, configuration of enterprise custom rest days and compensatory leave days, automatic adaptation of holiday attendance rules, and date baseline maintenance for leave quota calculation. |
| Attendance Management | Attendance Settings | Attendance Period | Defines attendance periods and pay calculation periods; supports custom period start/end times, period length (monthly/weekly/bi-weekly), and period settlement rules; can link to attendance calculation and payroll calculation modules to automatically aggregate, settle, and archive attendance data by period; supports cross-period data traceability and adjustment. | Standardized setup of enterprise attendance settlement periods, monthly/weekly attendance data aggregation and settlement, matching of attendance data baselines for payroll calculation, process control of cross-period attendance adjustments, and historical data archiving and query for attendance periods. |
| Attendance Management | Attendance Rules | Clock-in Rules | Defines rules for various attendance scenarios; supports flexible custom configuration; can configure mobile clock-in addresses and attendance-as-clock-in settings. | Standardized control of daily employee clock-in behavior and adaptation of clock-in rules for office, field work, and remote work scenarios. |
| Attendance Management | Attendance Rules | Clock Correction Rules | Custom rules for clock correction applications after missed or forgotten clock-ins; configurable effective time limits, frequency limits, and activation rules for clock correction. | Standardized control of clock correction behavior after missed clock-ins and limits on correction frequency and time windows. |
| Attendance Management | Attendance Rules | Overtime Rules | Custom enterprise-wide overtime rules; configurable effective overtime application periods, overtime duration calculation standards, overtime type classification (workday/rest day/statutory holiday), overtime compensatory leave/overtime pay calculation rules, and overtime exemption rules; supports differentiated rule configuration by department or employee. | Standardized control of employee overtime behavior and automatic accumulation of overtime duration and compensatory leave quotas for different overtime types in payroll calculation. |
| Attendance Management | Attendance Rules | Outing & Business Trip Rules | Custom attendance management rules for employee outings and business trips; configurable duration calculation standards and attendance adaptation rules for outing/business trip applications; supports automatic synchronization of attendance status via linked itinerary data. | Attendance management for employee field work and business travel. |
| Attendance Management | Leave Rules | Leave Type | Custom leave types and leave units; supports configuration of leave name, leave unit (day/hour/half day), leave duration limits, and quota limits; adapts to enterprise management needs for paid and unpaid leave. | Enterprise leave system setup and standardization, custom configuration of annual leave, sick leave, personal leave, marriage leave, maternity leave, and other leave types, differentiated leave rule management, and attendance and payroll calculation adaptation for leave data. |
| Attendance Management | Leave Rules | Quota Rules | Custom quota rules and quota distribution rules for leave types. | Full lifecycle management of employee leave quotas, automatic issuance and calculation of paid leave quotas such as annual leave, differentiated quota configuration by job level and tenure, and real-time tracking and audit of leave quota usage. |
| Attendance Management | Leave & Attendance Forms | Clock Correction Form | Clock correction form application and record viewing; involves data linkage. | Clock correction application and approval after missed or forgotten clock-ins, correction of abnormal attendance data, compliance control of clock correction behavior, and linked updates to attendance calculation data. |
| Attendance Management | Leave & Attendance Forms | Leave Application | Leave form application and record viewing; involves data linkage; automatically validates leave type, available quota, and leave duration compliance; synchronously updates attendance status and leave balance; supports leave form record viewing and data traceability. | Application and approval of annual leave, sick leave, personal leave, marriage leave, and other leave types; real-time quota validation and deduction; attendance status management during employee leave; and end-to-end leave process control. |
| Attendance Management | Leave & Attendance Forms | Leave Cancellation Form | Supports leave cancellation applications and approval after leave ends; automatically validates actual leave duration; synchronously updates leave balance and attendance calculation results; supports leave cancellation form record viewing and data traceability. | Leave cancellation procedures when employees end leave early, compliance validation of actual leave duration, quota adjustment (refund or additional deduction), and correction of attendance calculation data. |
| Attendance Management | Leave & Attendance Forms | Overtime Application | Supports employee overtime applications and full-process approval management; automatically validates overtime duration, overtime type, and compliance requirements; synchronously updates overtime duration accumulation, compensatory leave quota, or overtime pay calculation results; supports overtime form record viewing and data traceability. | Application and approval of overtime on workdays, rest days, and statutory holidays; compliance control of overtime duration; automatic accumulation of compensatory leave quota; and matching of foundational data for overtime pay calculation. |
| Attendance Management | Leave & Attendance Forms | Business Trip Form | Supports business trip form application and record viewing; involves data linkage. | Application and approval of business trips and attendance status management during business trips. |
| Attendance Management | Leave & Attendance Reports | Daily Attendance Detail Report | Displays employee attendance detail data by day, including attendance status, late arrival/early departure/absenteeism/leave/overtime details, leave usage, and raw clock-in data; supports multi-dimensional filtering, query, and export. | Daily attendance detail query, verification and investigation of abnormal attendance data, detail validation of attendance calculation results, daily monitoring of employee attendance behavior, and export of attendance detail data for compliance audit. |
| Attendance Management | Leave & Attendance Reports | Monthly Attendance Summary Report | Aggregates full-month employee attendance data by month, including total attendance hours, late arrival/early departure/absenteeism/leave/overtime summaries, scheduled vs. actual attendance days, and attendance anomaly summaries; supports multi-dimensional filtering, aggregation, query, and export. | Enterprise monthly attendance data aggregation, overall assessment of employee monthly attendance, validation of monthly attendance calculation results, and matching of attendance foundational data for payroll calculation. |
| Attendance Management | Leave & Attendance Reports | Leave Balance Report | Displays total quota, used quota, remaining available quota, and accumulated quota details for each leave type; supports multi-dimensional filtering, query, and export by leave type, employee, and department; synchronously updates leave usage and quota change data. | Real-time query of remaining leave quotas, tracking and control of leave usage, compliance validation of leave quotas, pre-approval quota review for leave applications, and annual aggregation of leave quota data. |
| Attendance Management | Leave & Attendance Reports | Clock-in Records Report | Displays raw detail records of all employee clock-in activities, including clock-in time, location, device, type, and status; supports multi-dimensional filtering, query, traceability, and export by employee, time, and clock-in status. | Traceability and verification of raw clock-in data, investigation and evidence collection for abnormal attendance behavior, compliance validation of clock-in data, foundational data support for attendance disputes, and full archiving and compliance audit of clock-in records. |
| Payroll Management | Payroll Profile | Clock-in Records Report | Automatically created after employee onboarding is completed; serves as the core foundational repository for employee payroll calculation; supports maintenance, update, and full lifecycle management of payroll standards, payroll structure, bank card information, individual income tax information, social insurance and housing fund information, and all payroll-related data. | Initialization and maintenance of payroll profiles after new employee onboarding, profile updates for payroll structure adjustments, foundational data support for employee payroll calculation, compliant maintenance of employee bank card information, and full lifecycle traceability and compliance audit of payroll profiles. |
| Payroll Management | Social Insurance & Housing Fund | Social Insurance Profile | Core management repository for enterprise social insurance and housing fund enrolled personnel; supports maintenance, update, and full lifecycle management of enrollment status, enrollment location, insurance types, contribution base, contribution rates, and account information; synchronizes employee employment status and payroll profile data. | Scope management of enrolled personnel, maintenance of employee social insurance and housing fund account information, real-time updates of enrollment status, foundational data support for social insurance and housing fund calculation, and compliance audit and reporting of enrolled personnel data. |
| Payroll Management | Social Insurance & Housing Fund | Enrollment Rules | Supports custom configuration of social insurance and housing fund enrollment rules by region and insurance type, including local policy adaptation, contribution base limits, contribution rates, enrollment timing rules, retroactive contribution rules, and insurance type adaptation rules; supports enterprise-specific rule configuration and activation management. | Adaptation and configuration of cross-region enrollment rules, implementation of social insurance and housing fund compliance policies, standardized control of contribution bases and rates, batch update and activation of enrollment rules, rule support for social insurance and housing fund calculation, and risk control for compliance policies. |
| Payroll Management | Individual Income Tax | Personal Income Tax Profile | Core foundational profile for employee individual income tax calculation; supports maintenance, update, and full lifecycle management of special additional deduction information, tax filing status, accumulated tax data, and all individual income tax-related information; synchronizes payroll profile and employee employment status data. | Compliant maintenance of employee tax filing identity, update and management of special additional deduction information, and foundational data support for employee individual income tax calculation. |
| Payroll Management | Individual Income Tax | Personal Income Tax Rules | Supports custom configuration of individual income tax calculation and filing rules, including tax threshold and tax rate tables; supports enterprise-specific rule configuration and activation management. | Configuration of enterprise-specific individual income tax calculation rules, standardized control of individual income tax calculation, and rule support for individual income tax filing. |
| Payroll Management | Individual Income Tax | Personal Income Tax Calculation | Supports accurate calculation of employee monthly individual income tax amounts. | Individual income tax amount estimation after new onboarding or salary adjustment, tax recalculation after updates to special additional deductions, and individual income tax compliance validation. |
| Payroll Management | Payroll Rules | Payroll Template | Supports custom configuration of payroll items for payroll calculation, reports, and payslip display; configurable item names, types, calculation logic, addition/subtraction rules, and display order; adapts to differentiated payroll structures across positions and levels. | Setup of standardized enterprise payroll calculation systems, configuration of differentiated payroll structures by position and department, definition of display rules for payroll reports and payslips, and standardized control of payroll calculation logic. |
| Payroll Management | Payroll Rules | Pay Calculation Rules | Includes various rule configurations across the full payroll calculation process; supports custom configuration of attendance deduction rules, performance calculation rules, overtime pay calculation rules, leave deduction rules, social insurance and housing fund withholding rules, individual income tax withholding rules, and subsidy/bonus calculation rules; includes system preset general compliance rules; supports activation and version management of enterprise-specific rules. | Standardized control of full-process payroll calculation rules, definition of calculation logic for attendance, performance, overtime, and other payroll items, adaptation of differentiated pay calculation rules across regions and positions, payroll calculation compliance validation, and automatic rule execution for monthly payroll calculation. |
| Payroll Management | Payroll Calculation | Pay Calculation Rules | Based on configured payroll templates and pay calculation rules, automatically integrates data from attendance, performance, social insurance and housing fund, and individual income tax modules to accurately calculate gross pay, deductions, net pay, and all payroll data for the current period. | Full-process monthly and annual employee payroll calculation for the enterprise. |
| Payroll Management | Payroll Reports | Payroll Detail Report | Displays full employee payroll detail data by month or period, including gross pay items, deduction items, net pay amount, individual income tax, social insurance and housing fund, and all payroll item details; supports multi-dimensional filtering, query, aggregation, and export; synchronizes full details of payroll calculation results. | Query and verification of employee monthly payroll details, detail validation of payroll calculation results, and export of payroll detail data. |
| Payroll Management | Payroll Reports | Social Insurance Report | Automatically generates full social insurance and housing fund data reports based on social insurance profiles and enrollment rules; supports report query and export. | Enterprise monthly social insurance and housing fund aggregation and settlement. |
| Payroll Management | Payroll Reports | IIT Report | Automatically generates full individual income tax data reports based on IIT profiles and IIT rules, including accumulated income, accumulated deductions, taxable amount, prepaid tax, and tax payable/refundable amounts; supports export. | Monthly individual income tax detail data query for employees. |
| Payroll Management | Payslip | IIT Report | Automatically synchronizes payroll calculation results and generates and records detailed monthly payroll data for each employee. | Generation and distribution of employee monthly payslips, and online viewing and acknowledgment of employee payroll details. |

---
